entries.title: The future of the firm
entries.last_summary: Organizations are increasingly integrating AI into internal operations, with companies like Sea Limited deploying coding tools and Omio leveraging OpenAI for travel experiences. Additionally, OpenAI is introducing educational features like a College Planner into ChatGPT.

entries.title: OpenAI’s Frontier Governance Framework
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has published its Frontier Governance Framework, which outlines security and safety practices intended to align with emerging EU and California regulations.

entries.title: First look at GPT-5
entries.last_summary: Leading developers have been given early access to test the capabilities of GPT-5.

entries.title: OpenAI Five Benchmark: Results
entries.last_summary: OpenAI Five successfully defeated a team of high-level professional Dota players in a benchmark match, demonstrating advancements in agentic performance.

entries.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
entries.last_summary: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber, a specialized model designed to identify and fix cybersecurity vulnerabilities within authorized scopes.

entries.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has released a National Community Compact and a Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to guide responsible development of infrastructure for data centers.

entries.title: Franklin Templeton uses OpenAI to support investment research
entries.last_summary: Franklin Templeton is implementing AI workflows powered by OpenAI to assist portfolio managers with equity research and investment risk assessment.

entries.title: The Download: Texas’s fragile AI boom and energy policy shifts
entries.last_summary: The rapid expansion of data centers in Texas faces potential setbacks due to energy policy shifts and community resistance to infrastructure buildouts.

entries.title: OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects
entries.last_summary: Following local opposition, OpenAI has committed to eliminating non-disclosure agreements with public officials for future data center development projects.

entries.title: Airbnb is working on an AI travel agent
entries.last_summary: Airbnb announced in its Q3 2026 shareholder letter that it plans to release an AI travel agent in early 2027 to assist users with booking and planning.

entries.title: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
entries.last_summary: Perplexity has launched "Teammates," a suite of always-on AI agents for work that integrate with existing projects and the Perplexity Computer system.

entries.title: Our approach to government and national security partnerships
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has published new principles regarding its partnerships with government and national security entities, emphasizing democratic accountability and safety. The update also includes the introduction of a Media Manager tool for content creators.

entries.title: How Ramp engineers accelerate code review with Codex
entries.last_summary: Engineers at Ramp are utilizing Codex, integrated with GPT-5.5, to automate and accelerate the code review process. This integration reportedly reduces the time required for substantive code feedback from hours to minutes.

entries.title: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash: Fast and cost-effective with longer clips
entries.last_summary: Google has announced Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash, a new model iteration optimized for speed and cost-efficiency. The update includes expanded support for processing longer video clips.

entries.title: Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has partnered with security firm Hacktron to identify vulnerabilities within its systems and test third-party service connections.

entries.title: Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has introduced BioBasicsBench, a new benchmark designed to evaluate how AI agents interpret raw experimental data and perform tasks within wet-lab scientific settings.

entries.title: China reportedly recruited AI exec to spy on Jensen Huang
entries.last_summary: Reports suggest a Chinese intelligence agency recruited an executive from Megaspeed to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to gain insights into US advanced AI chip strategy.

entries.title: Lame-duck Congress might actually do something: speed up energy projects
entries.last_summary: The US Congress is considering a bipartisan permitting reform bill aimed at accelerating energy projects, which could significantly impact the infrastructure needed for data centers.

entries.title: Meta’s Muse AI can create custom ‘spaces’ for the version of the app you need right now
entries.last_summary: Meta has introduced 'Spaces' for its Muse AI assistant, allowing users to build and customize specific app-like interfaces for tasks such as shopping, music tracking, or gaming.

entries.title: Crusoe sells troubled Wyoming data center project to Google
entries.last_summary: Google has acquired a struggling data center project in Wyoming from energy infrastructure firm Crusoe.

entries.title: Hundreds of Artex AI hacking tools found publicly exposed to the web
entries.last_summary: Security researchers have discovered hundreds of instances where servers hosting the 'Artex' penetration testing tool were left publicly exposed to the internet.

entries.title: Pentagon offers battery startup 6K $250M loan to build US factory
entries.last_summary: The Pentagon has conditionally approved a $250 million loan to battery material startup 6K to support the scaling of its microwave-plasma manufacturing process.

entries.title: Teaching with AI
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has released a new educational guide for teachers on using ChatGPT, covering integration strategies and limitations. Concurrently, researchers are exploring novel methods for AI-driven 4D reconstruction and self-teaching models without human data.

entries.title: Welcome Le Chonk: Mistral Large 4 on Hugging Face
entries.last_summary: Mistral AI has released 'Mistral Large 4,' now available on Hugging Face.

entries.title: The Download: a humanoid cleans house and Samsung builds for the AI boom
entries.last_summary: New reports highlight the growing integration of humanoid robots in domestic tasks and Samsung's ongoing infrastructure investments to support the AI chip boom.

entries.title: The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China
entries.last_summary: Investigations reveal that high-end Nvidia AI chips were approved for export to an empty shell office in China, raising questions about current vetting processes.

entries.title: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers
entries.last_summary: A report by the AI safety group METR indicates that Anthropic's internal AI development capabilities are accelerating significantly, leading to faster model improvement cycles.

entries.title: After the midterms, is the AI industry in for a rough two years?
entries.last_summary: Recent US election results suggest a challenging environment for the AI industry, with voters increasingly supporting local restrictions on data center development.

entries.title: “Does Meta think we can’t read?” Meta abandons sketchy commercial terms update.
entries.last_summary: Following user backlash, Meta has abandoned a proposed terms of service update that would have required Facebook page owners to allow AI training on their linked content.

entries.title: Consumer brain wave headsets threaten privacy
entries.last_summary: New concerns have emerged regarding consumer brain-wave headsets that may be harvesting neurological data to train AI models without explicit user consent.

entries.title: The end of Microsoft Research's AI Frontiers group
entries.last_summary: Microsoft has disbanded its AI Frontiers group within Microsoft Research, leading to the departure of prominent researchers.

entries.title: The full stack behind abundant intelligence
entries.last_summary: OpenAI is pursuing a full-stack infrastructure strategy to improve AI accessibility and scale, including the development of a 1GW data center project in Michigan. The initiative focuses on integrating hardware and compute resources to reduce costs and increase model performance.

entries.title: Here’s the full text of Jensen Huang’s memo to Nvidia
entries.last_summary: Nvidia has launched an investigation into CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with Alice Huang, an executive linked to the Chinese government. Jensen Huang has issued a memo to employees acknowledging the situation.

entries.title: Apple is racing to make Siri more agentic
entries.last_summary: Apple leadership is reportedly pressuring engineering teams to accelerate the development of an agentic version of Siri. This effort seeks to close the gap with emerging AI agents from competitors like OpenAI and Meta.

entries.title: Chatbots might be coming to Apple’s HomeView
entries.last_summary: Beta code in iOS 27.3 suggests Apple may be planning to introduce support for chatbots within its HomeView smart home hub. A new category for 'Conversational Apps' indicates potential integration for services like ChatGPT or Claude.

entries.title: OpenAI acquires TBPN
entries.last_summary: OpenAI has acquired TBPN to support independent media and is integrating technology from software firm Sky into ChatGPT for improved desktop capabilities.

entries.title: Introducing Businesses in ChatGPT
entries.last_summary: OpenAI introduced a suite of new ChatGPT business features, including workspace agents for workflow automation and security enhancements like Lockdown Mode.

entries.title: Introducing the Agents API
entries.last_summary: OpenAI and Amazon Bedrock have launched new developer-focused tools, including an Agents API and enhanced runtime support for multi-step workflows.

entries.title: How AI training scales
entries.last_summary: Researchers identified 'gradient noise scale' as a predictor for neural network parallelizability, suggesting future growth can be managed through larger batch sizes.

entries.title: Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth
entries.last_summary: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Code agents utilized millions of lines of code in Lean to verify Signal's encryption protocols.

entries.title: BotPsy: On-Device Personal Assistant with a Sub-Billion-Parameter Agentic Language Model
entries.last_summary: BotPsy is a new sub-billion-parameter language model designed for on-device agentic tasks.

entries.title: United won’t let your AI agent book your flight
entries.last_summary: United Airlines has restricted the use of AI agents for booking tickets, citing privacy and regulatory compliance concerns.

entries.title: Google’s Tabletop AI experiment lets you build custom collaboration apps
entries.last_summary: Google launched 'Tabletop,' an experimental tool that allows users to create customized collaborative apps using natural language prompts.
